# Haram Taxi Service

> Saudi Arabia's trusted private taxi company specialising in airport transfers, Umrah and Hajj pilgrim transport, intercity routes, and city tours. Fixed rates, no pre-payment, 24/7 availability. Licensed professional drivers. Serving Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Riyadh, and all major Saudi cities.

- Contact: haramtaxiservice@gmail.com | WhatsApp: +966575806733
- Website: https://haramtaxiservice.com
- Operating area: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

- [Home](https://haramtaxiservice.com/): Overview of services, fleet, and booking

- [All Routes](https://haramtaxiservice.com/routes): Full list of intercity taxi routes across Saudi Arabia
- [All Services](https://haramtaxiservice.com/services): Full list of taxi services (airport, Umrah, tours, corporate, etc.)
- [Fleet](https://haramtaxiservice.com/fleet): Vehicle options — Toyota Camry, GMC Yukon, Hyundai Staria, Hyundai Starex, Toyota Hiace, Toyota Coaster

- [Blog](https://haramtaxiservice.com/blog): Travel guides, pilgrim tips, and route information
